photos.title: The Palace and Landmark Resort from above
photos.what: The Palace and Landmark Resort from above (USDA NAIP aerial photo, 2023): The Palace, a tall tower with a blue-gray roof, stands on the beach at the lower left; Landmark Resort, a larger white-roofed tower, stands next door to the north-east; the beach and the Atlantic Ocean run along the lower right. Labels placed from coordinates (labels.json).
photos.caption: The Palace from above, on the beach, with Landmark Resort next door.
photos.alt: Aerial photo of the Palace Resort tower on the beach in Myrtle Beach, labelled, with Landmark Resort next door and the Atlantic Ocean
photos.author: USDA Farm Service Agency, NAIP
photos.provenance: U.S. government aerial photo: USDA National Agriculture Imagery Program (NAIP), South Carolina 2023, natural color, 60 cm. Exported by Chapter3 from the USGS National Map NAIP image service (exportImage, Web Mercator, cubic resampling, mosaic locked to Year=2023) on 2026-11-13; the exact request is in source_request.
